name: TUMTraf V2X — Cooperative Roadside and Onboard Dataset
description: Cooperative vehicle-to-infrastructure autonomous driving dataset recorded on the Providentia++ intelligent highway and urban testbed near Munich by the Technical University of Munich (TUM). Features synchronized multimodal sensor data pairing roadside gantry sensors (traffic cameras and LiDARs) with onboard vehicle sensors (cameras and LiDAR). Provides accurately calibrated 3D bounding boxes and tracking IDs across complex highway and intersection driving conditions.
